name: Ishkibal of Nuradan
source:
Ishkibal of Nuradan is the headmaster of the Old Yru Academy of Medicine and Healing. He is a man of great reputation, renowned as a scholar and an administrator.

[Edited from [url=https://everblossom.miraheze.org/wiki/Ishkibal_of_Nuradan]The Flower That Bloomed Nowhere Wiki[/url]]
